data.one_liner: A command-line tool to execute Dart and Flutter tests at high speed.
data.what_it_does: Bundles tests into a single file to significantly reduce overall test suite runtime. Provides parallel worker isolate execution, coverage tracking, and test isolation diagnostics.
use_when: Your Flutter test suite is large and takes a long time to run
You want to run tests in parallel using native isolate concurrency
You need to track code coverage and test trends over time
avoid_when: Your tests depend heavily on strict sequential execution and are not isolated
You are not using the command line for running tests
strengths: Significant reduction in test runtime via test bundling
Blazing-fast native parallel execution using isolate sharding
Integrated test reporting and interactive HTML trend visualization
weaknesses: Tests that share state may fail because they are not truly isolated
Diagnostic doctor command is currently experimental
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using dart pub global activate test_rocket.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard built-in Dart testing package if you do not require bundling or custom parallel sharding tools.
